versions.changelog:
- Enforces strict CLI execution for all travel queries; answers must use flyai CLI output only.
- Adds detailed output and parameter collection SOP, plus scenario-based playbooks (recommended, cheapest, fastest, direct).
- Mandates booking links ([Book](...)) in every result; never answer from knowledge/training data.
- Clarifies when not to trigger this skill (e.g., hotel or nature-spot queries).
- Includes more robust environment checks and fallback instructions.
